summary: Backend-only testing for MIXDECK DJ streaming MVP. Created pytest suite covering 24 tests across root/seed, auth, admin protection, mix CRUD, public duration, CUE parsing, audio upload + HTTP Range streaming, cover upload, and delete. All 24 tests passed (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: parse_cue treats 'INDEX 01' string-compared to '01' (m_idx.group(1) == '01') which works but would be safer as int comparison == 1 to also handle 'INDEX 1' variants.
public_set_duration only sets when duration is falsy; no upper bound validation (could accept negative/huge values). Low priority.
CORS allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers will ignore credentials. Fine for public streaming MVP but worth noting.
DELETE /api/admin/mixes/{id} does not unlink the associated .cue file under storage/cues/ (only audio + cover). Minor cleanup gap.
Streaming endpoint falls through to 404 when only audio_url (external URL) is set on a mix - consider redirecting to audio_url or documenting that /api/stream/{id} is local-file only.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ prefixed mixes during runs; all deleted via fixtures teardown. /api/seed-demo used (idempotent - second call returns skipped=true).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. CUE parser confirmed: start_seconds = [0.0, 225.0, 492.4] for the provided sample. Range streaming returns 206 with correct Content-Range and Accept-Ranges headers. No MongoDB _id leaks detected in any response. Admin auth enforced on all /api/admin/* routes. Frontend was explicitly skipped in this request.
